newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firm to steady, mostly quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm to steady, mostly quiet.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer to steady, but trade was muted in a thin market.
Cold weather in Europe and a surprise fall in U.S. distillate stocks lifted outright gas oil values and barge premiums.
Gasoline prices edged up by $1-$2 a tonne, propelled by modest gains on Brent crude futures.

Activity in the fuel barge market was reasonable with up to 15,000 tonnes of bunker interest. Prompt material sold for $111 a tonne, second half Jan for $115. Heavy selling by a refiner, because of plant problems, has now ceased.
